claim: For ternary words of length five, the largest one-deletion-correcting code has exactly 24 codewords: \(N(5,3,1)=24\).
integrity: The lower bound is a directly checked 24-word code. The upper bound is an exact rational dual certificate checked over all 243 input words with integer arithmetic; no floating-point optimizer is needed for replay.
limitations: The result is specific to ternary length-five single-deletion correction; it does not classify extremizers or provide a general formula. A terminology-shifted or unindexed small-parameter computation remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Exact ternary length-five single-deletion code size
